items.name: Registry health scorecard discovery
items.description: Validate member willingness to act on proactive registry-quality and routing-security recommendations.
questions: Which health signals feel actionable rather than punitive?
Which recommendations need RIPE NCC guidance versus member-only action?
How should members delegate scorecard ownership internally?

items.name: Policy evidence pack discovery
items.description: Validate which evidence types help policy participants understand operational and regional impact.
questions: Which evidence should be required for high-impact proposals?
What caveats prevent misleading policy interpretation?
How should evidence updates be handled during long proposal cycles?
